notes: Complete maintained host matrix:107 commands covering host regressions, remaining frozen reference regressions, Python unittest discovery, native host parity, image-translation smoke checks and first-party sanitizer probes. The seven historical Web quality implementations have native production replacements covering418 original scenario groups; those execute separately in the three mandatory native-quality iOS suites and unfiltered AidokuFull.
Node overlay tests execute frozen historical Web reference sources under AidokuTests/Translation/LegacyBrowserOverlay, not production browser rendering.
Scripts/native-render-parity contains historical research/capture probes and original migration experiments; those are not a maintained test suite. Current native regressions live in AidokuTests.
External saved-page corpus replays require explicit fixture inputs and are diagnostic tools, not silently skipped entries in this matrix. Vendor package tests have separate package entry points.

Self-contained historical WebKit fixture tests require the existing Playwright WebKit runtime; set PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE to its installed package. Tests run sequentially; missing runtime is a failure, never a skip.

Historical quality scripts remain available by their exact commands under nativeQualityReplacement. They are offline evidence of the frozen Web implementation, not skipped entries or expected failures in the production host matrix. Native quality CI runs all three replacement suites and rejects zero executed, skipped, failed and expected-failure tests.

nativeQualityReplacement.contractPolicy: The historical assertions below describe the unchanged frozen Web scripts. Native coverage preserves the full fixture/scenario matrix and reviewed semantic contracts, with the explicit area-counter replacements recorded here; it does not claim every historical numeric assertion is unchanged.

nativeContractDifferences.historicalContract: The positive crop expected exactly 2798 painted pixels.
nativeContractDifferences.nativeContract: Require all 500 independently annotated owned lettering pixels to be erased and all 20652 protected artwork pixels to remain unpainted. Retain the original method, acceptance/rejection matrix, input immutability and nonempty spatial/luminance proof checks.
nativeContractDifferences.reason: Painted area counts include non-glyph padding and cannot establish whether letters were removed or artwork preserved.
nativeContractDifferences.annotationSource: Immutable source RGB and preexisting 0d22699e ownership footprint; current renderer output is not an annotation input.

nativeContractDifferences.historicalContract: The two crops required painted areas of at least 54000 and 57000 pixels.
nativeContractDifferences.nativeContract: Require zero remaining annotated owned colored-core pixels, zero remaining annotated white-band pixels, and zero painted protected artwork pixels. Retain exact source hashes, immutable inputs and the two-pixel unpainted crop border.
nativeContractDifferences.reason: A padding-area lower bound can reward painting unowned material. The second native crop painted 55338 pixels while removing every annotated core/white-band pixel and preserving its protected frame.
nativeContractDifferences.annotationSource: Original source RGB/components and immutable rotated OCR quad; no renderer output is an annotation input.

captures.ownershipCorrection: Two complete punctuation components extend 36-41 source pixels outside the immutable OCR quad and have no auxiliary ownership: their 1600 core pixels and 809 solid-white pixels are protected. The 1147 mixed off-white fringe/backing pixels are unannotated because source geometry alone does not establish stroke ownership. All six owned components retain complete core/white-band assertions.

unchangedExactContracts: Original fixture JSON, source RGBA and frozen Web scripts remain unchanged.
Body/art restoration still checks the six exact output RGBA hashes and exact ownership-mask hashes.
Admission booleans, owned glyph/ruby removal, artwork/neighbor protection, input immutability and budgets are not relaxed by raster transport tolerance.
